name: domain-rdap-lookup
title: WHOIS Domain Lookup via RDAP: Created, Expiry, Registrar, DNS
description: Bulk WHOIS-style domain lookup through the registries' official RDAP servers (the successor of WHOIS): registered or not, creation and expiry dates, days until expiry, registrar, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. Clean JSON, no contact data.
